seg.notes: Segment revenues include freight, delivery & transportation revenues (Aggregates footnote), so seg.delivery_rev is null (not shown separately in the segment table; consolidated freight & delivery revenues are in is.delivery_rev). Only Aggregates has intersegment sales. Calcium segment = calcium products (Florida). Asphalt/Concrete cash GP not published in release (null).

is.notes: Pre-2018 presentation: income statement shows only 'Total revenues' (freight & delivery revenues included). is.delivery_rev = 'Freight and delivery revenues' and is.net_sales = 'Total revenues excluding freight and delivery revenues' from the release's non-GAAP gross-margin reconciliation (published figures, not computed). No noncontrolling interest (nci = 0). dps = cash dividends per share as shown in the release/10-Q statement of earnings. ASU 2016-09 (excess tax benefits of share-based comp through income tax) was early adopted in Q4-16 retroactive to 1-Jan-2016; this quarter is AS ORIGINALLY REPORTED (pre-adoption). Later filings recast it (tax lower, net earnings higher), so Q1+Q2+Q3+Q4 tax/net earnings do not sum to FY2016.

ngaap.notes: EBITDA (Vulcan definition) excludes discontinued operations: the Net earnings->EBITDA reconciliation adds back income tax (continuing ops), interest expense, net, and '(Earnings) loss on discontinued operations, net of tax' (captured in extra field ebitda_bridge_disc_ops_addback), then DDA&A. Hence the schema check ni_vulcan + tax + interest + total_dda = ebitda_pub only holds after adding ebitda_bridge_disc_ops_addback; adj_items.disc_ops is null (not an EBITDA->Adjusted EBITDA item). ebitda_bridge_lines = EBITDA->Adjusted EBITDA lines (zero lines kept as published). Adjusted EPS bridge from release text (no table in Q2-16 release). 'Recovery from legal settlement' = business interruption claims recovery (2010 Gulf Coast oil spill); mapped to legal_env.
